tools.name: collmex_list_customers
tools.description: Search Collmex customers (record CUSTOMER_GET): by customer number, free text (name, city, e-mail ...), postal code or country. Returns address, contact, bank (IBAN/BIC), VAT id, payment terms, agent and status fields. Inactive customers are left out unless asked for.

tools.name: collmex_list_vendors
tools.description: Search Collmex vendors/suppliers (record VENDOR_GET): by vendor number, free text, postal code or country. Returns address, contact, bank, VAT id, payment terms and expense account fields.

tools.name: collmex_list_addresses
tools.description: Search the Collmex address book (record ADDRESS_GET): customers, vendors and address-book entries in one list, optionally with their contact persons. address_type: 0 all, 1 customers, 2 vendors, 3 address-book entries.

tools.name: collmex_list_products
tools.description: Search Collmex products (record PRODUCT_GET): by product number, product group, free text (number, description, remark, GTIN, manufacturer) or price group. Returns description, unit, tax class, sales price, purchase data and stock settings.

tools.name: collmex_get_available_stock
tools.description: Currently available stock per product (record STOCK_AVAILABLE_GET): on-hand stock of the available stock types minus demand due today or earlier. A service product shows (NULL). Leave product_no empty for every product.

tools.name: collmex_list_invoices
tools.description: Search Collmex customer invoices and credit notes (record INVOICE_GET): by invoice number, customer, invoice date range, customer order or product. Each invoice has its header (customer address, dates, payment terms, status code: 0 new, 10 to be posted, 20 open, 30 dunned, 40 settled, 100 deleted) a

tools.name: collmex_list_sales_orders
tools.description: Search Collmex customer orders (record SALES_ORDER_GET): by order number, customer, order date range or the customer's own order number. Each order has its header (customer address, dates, payment terms, status code: 0 new, 10 confirmed, 30 paid, 50 delivered, 90 invoiced, 100 done, 1000 cancelled)

tools.name: collmex_list_payment_terms
tools.description: The payment terms defined in Collmex (record TERMS_OF_PAYMENT_GET): number, description, payment method and discount periods. The number is what customers, vendors and invoices refer to as payment_terms.

tools.name: collmex_list_open_items
tools.description: Open items (unpaid invoices) from the Collmex accounting (record OPEN_ITEMS_GET), for customers (receivables, default) or vendors (payables). Returns invoice number, document and due date, days overdue, dunning level, amount, paid and outstanding. Optionally as of a key date.

tools.name: collmex_list_accounting_documents
tools.description: Accounting postings (record ACCDOC_GET), one row per posting position: posting number, date, text, account, debit/credit (0 debit, 1 credit), amount, customer/vendor, invoice number. tools.name: collmex_get_account_balances
tools.description: Account balances from the Collmex accounting (record ACCBAL_GET) for a fiscal year: account number, name and balance. tools.name: collmex_list_projects
tools.description: Collmex projects (record PROJECT_GET) with customer, budget, value of recorded activities, completion state and the project's rates (rate number, description, product, hourly or daily rate).

tools.name: collmex_list_activities
tools.description: Recorded time-tracking activities (record ACTIVITIES_GET): project, employee, date, from/to times, breaks, description, and the invoice that billed it. Filter by project, employee (needs company), date range, only not-yet-billed or only invoice-relevant activities.
